story.heading: Story time..
story.paragraph1: You're juggling long work hours, family responsibilities, and maybe a workout or two—only to realize your eating habits are all over the place. You want to feel healthier, perhaps lose a bit of weight, but conflicting advice and busy schedules keep you stuck. Following rigid meal plans feels overwhelming, and those fad diets never seem to fit into your real life.
story.paragraph2: Enter DietlessAI, an app inspired by years of experience from a leading nutritionist, Erik and his work of helping people overcome the same struggles you face today. Dietless AI is designed to simplify nutrition, learn your tastes, and adapt to your daily routine, giving you the expert guidance you need to build a healthier, more balanced lifestyle.

how_it_works.question: How does DietlessAI work?
how_it_works.answer: DietlessAI uses advanced artificial intelligence to analyze your preferences, dietary requirements, and goals. It then creates personalized nutrition plans and provides real-time advice to help you achieve optimal health and wellness.

what_different.question: What makes Dietless AI different from other nutrition apps?
what_different.answer: Dietless AI adapts to your day-to-day routine, offering real-life solutions instead of rigid rules. Whether you're on the go or making a home-cooked meal, the app adjusts to your lifestyle.

dietary_needs.question: Is Dietless AI suitable for specific dietary needs?
dietary_needs.answer: Absolutely. Whether you're gluten-free, vegan, or focusing on moderate weight management, Dietless AI personalizes plans to fit your unique requirements.

update_frequency.question: How often does the app update my meal plan?
update_frequency.answer: Dietless AI monitors your progress and can update recommendations daily. It ensures your plan remains relevant, flexible, and aligned with your goals.

cancel_subscription.question: Can I cancel my subscription at any time?
cancel_subscription.answer: You can cancel your subscription at any time with no long-term commitments. If you cancel, you will continue to have access to DietlessAI until the end of your current billing period

ai_accuracy.question: How accurate is the AI nutrition advice?
ai_accuracy.answer: Our AI is trained on extensive, up-to-date nutrition data and provides evidence-based recommendations. While highly accurate for general nutrition advice, we always recommend consulting with healthcare professionals for specific medical conditions or concerns.

reliability.question: What makes Dietless AI reliable?
reliability.answer: Dietless AI is built on a foundation of rigorously researched, science-based nutrition principles. Its recommendations are informed by the most trusted insights in the field of nutrition, ensuring that your personalized plan is both effective and sustainable. Whether your goal is weight loss, maintaining your current weight, or simply eating healthier, you can feel confident that Dietless AI is designed to deliver evidence-backed results.

what_are_cookies.title: 1. What Are Cookies?
what_are_cookies.content: Cookies are small files stored on your device to help websites remember things like login status, preferences, and usage patterns. Most websites use them — including ours.

how_we_use.title: 2. How We Use Cookies
how_we_use.content:
DietlessAI uses cookies for two main reasons:
- To keep you logged in securely using a session cookie
- To track general site usage and email performance (via Klaviyo)

essential_cookies.title: 3. Essential Cookies
essential_cookies.content: We use a cookie to keep you securely logged in. It remembers who you are between visits and helps the app work properly. This cookie expires after a short time and doesn't store any personal information you can see.

analytics_marketing.title: 4. Analytics & Marketing Cookies
analytics_marketing.content: Klaviyo may use cookies to help us understand how people interact with our site and emails. These cookies are used for things like open rates and click tracking.

managing_cookies.title: 5. Managing Cookies
managing_cookies.content: You can control or block cookies in your browser settings at any time. Just be aware that disabling essential cookies may prevent you from logging into the app.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.content: This Privacy Policy describes how Dietless OÜ ("we", "us", or "our") collects, uses, and protects your personal information when you use the DietlessAI application. By accessing or using our service, you agree to this policy.

what_we_collect.title: 2. What Information We Collect
what_we_collect.content:
We collect only the essential personal data needed to operate the service:
- Email address (provided during sign-up or newsletter subscription)
Information such as weight, macros, or gender may be shared voluntarily during AI chat interactions, but we do not store these inputs in a structured or permanent form.

how_we_use.title: 3. How We Use Your Information
how_we_use.content:
We use your email to:
- Let you log into the app
- Send important updates, like subscription info
- Send you newsletters or product news if you’ve subscribed

cookies.title: 4. Cookies & Tracking
cookies.content: We use cookies to keep you logged in and to help improve the experience. Marketing tools like Klaviyo may also place cookies to better understand user behavior. You can manage or block cookies in your browser settings.

third_party.title: 5. Third-Party Services
third_party.content:
We rely on the following services to run DietlessAI:
- Stripe for payment processing
- OpenAI API to power our chat responses
- Klaviyo for email marketing and (optionally) analytics
- Resend for transactional email delivery

data_security.title: 6. Data Security
data_security.content: We take reasonable steps to protect your data using secure authentication, encrypted communications, and access controls. However, no system is 100% secure — use of the service is at your own risk.

your_rights.title: 7. Your Rights
your_rights.content: You may request deletion of your data by contacting us at dietlessai@dietless.ai. If you are subscribed to marketing emails, you can unsubscribe at any time using the link in the email.

ai_content.title: 8. AI-Generated Content
ai_content.content: All responses within the app are generated by an AI model and should not be considered professional advice. Do not rely on DietlessAI for decisions relating to medical treatment, nutrition for medical conditions, or any life-threatening scenarios.

changes.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify users via the app or email if material changes are made.

contact.title: 10. Contact
contact.content: For questions about this policy or your data, contact:
